activePromotions.title: 暖かい物語
activePromotions.officialDescription: 「誰かが“私”の部屋にいるみたい！」 有名作家の本葵は、深夜に目を覚ます。しかし、なかなか寝つけない……

activePromotions.title: Breakneck Transmission
activePromotions.officialDescription: A fast-paced, time trial package delivery racing game. Using mind bending warps to the laws of physics, deliver packages to their destinations quickly and prove that recklessness can be improved to regain a spot on a top racing team.

activePromotions.title: Mega Beast!
activePromotions.officialDescription: A epic action arcade reverse horror arcade compilation

activePromotions.title: Wireframe
activePromotions.officialDescription: Stem the tide of endless hordes of enemies in a new, retro styled, and fast paced arcade shooter game. Buy upgrades, and earn the highest score you can through mastery of movement, precision, and endurance.

activePromotions.title: Temporal Strike
activePromotions.officialDescription: Time-loop defense shooter. Aim yourself or let your squad fire on auto as orcs, goblins, boar riders and mechs flood in. Spend the loot on a 38-node upgrade tree, unlock five units, beat the boss waves, then rewind time for permanent upgrades.

activePromotions.title: House Zero
activePromotions.officialDescription: A social casino where the only thing at stake is bragging rights. Play 20+ games, from slots, Plinko and Crash to live poker and case battles with friends, using free play-money chips. Climb weekly leaderboards, finish quests and unlock cosmetics. No real-money gambling or payouts.

activePromotions.title: Immortal Zenith: Idle to Ascension
activePromotions.officialDescription: An MMO idle cultivation RPG grounded in unique systems and intentional randomness. Your characters meditate, break through cultivation realms, explore, master powerful techniques, collect legendary treasures, and ascend from mortal to immortal.

activePromotions.title: Glyphforge
activePromotions.officialDescription: Glyphforge is an magic roguelike with "anime style" spell-crafting. You write and compile nested spell formulas while kiting hostiles across an endless grid. In the most "I cant believe its another survivor-like game" manner possible.

activePromotions.title: Echoes of Calir
activePromotions.officialDescription: Echoes of Calir is a turn-based 1v1 mix of chess, a TCG and a board game on an 8×8 board. Build a deck of five units and five terrain cards, place them before battle, and outmaneuver your opponent through movement, abilities, and captures. Chess rules with the strategic depth of a TCG.

activePromotions.title: Where The Light Sleeps
activePromotions.officialDescription: A 7-minute dreamlike narrative adventure set among the ancient stones of Matera, Italy. Enter a young girl's dream in search of her grandmother, wandering through a strange and haunting world inhabited by unsettling, peculiar souls.

activePromotions.title: Trick Nor Treat
activePromotions.officialDescription: Enter a first-person horror experience inspired by folklore or legend. Explore haunting environments, investigate strange clues, record discoveries in your journal, and survive supernatural encounters. Learn the stories, follow the evidence, and decide what is hunting you before it's too late.

activePromotions.title: CHAOTIC VIRUS
activePromotions.officialDescription: この見下ろし型アクション・ローグライトで細胞を操作し、生き残りを目指そう。押し寄せるウイルスの群れを倒して経験値を獲得し、変異によって進化しながら、アクティブスキルとパッシブスキルを組み合わせて強力なビルドを作り上げよう。

activePromotions.title: 脳爆弾 - 序章
activePromotions.officialDescription: 概念は爆弾。連想は死。カルト的な雰囲気漂うディストピア心理ホラーパズルゲーム。被験体の脳には概念爆弾が埋め込まれており、特定の[起爆ワード]を連想した瞬間、頭部が破裂する。「認知爆弾処理班」として、致命的な「脳内爆弾」を解除せよ。

activePromotions.title: ファウンデーション：銀河フロンティア
activePromotions.officialDescription: アシモフ公式ライセンスによる『ファウンデーション』の世界で、星間行商人として生きる。交易航路を開拓・発展させ、自分だけの星艦を作り上げよう。激烈な上陸作戦で敵を殲滅し、大規模宇宙戦争では艦隊戦術で敵を圧倒しよう。常に進化を続ける新コンテンツが、君の銀河サーガをさらなる高みへと導いていく。この壮大な物語は、まだ始まったばかりだ。

activePromotions.title: Possessed By Fate
activePromotions.officialDescription: A yuri romance. After a ghost takes her apartment, a ghost hunter becomes the hunted—with her body the prize.

activePromotions.title: PAYDAY 3
activePromotions.officialDescription: 『PAYDAY 3』は1〜4人協力プレイのFPSであり、世界一象徴的な街を舞台にした究極のヒーストファンタジーだ。痕跡を残さず消え去るか、銃弾の雨をくぐり抜けるか。どちらにせよ、獲物を手に脱出しろ。
tags: オンライン協力プレイ
一騎当千方式シューティング

activePromotions.title: Age of Wonders 4
activePromotions.officialDescription: 自分でデザインしたファンタジーの世界を統治しよう！ 4Xストラテジーと戦略的なターン制バトルが特異な融合を果たした「Age of Wonders」で、新たな魔法の世界を探検しよう。ターンごとに発展していく帝国とともに成長・変化する派閥を支配しよう！
tags: ターン制ストラテジー
